name: Ricardo Alonso Garcia
bio:
Ricardo's journey into the world of motorsports began unexpectedly through a family connection to a mechanic working in Formula 3. Initially assisting with team logistics, he quickly found his niche in managing the nutritional needs and catering for the team, recognizing the direct impact of high-quality meals on performance. Over the years, Ricardo has honed his skills, developing an understanding of the specific dietary requirements of drivers and team members under intense pressure.

At MP Motorsport Junior, Ricardo meticulously plans menus, sources ingredients locally, and ensures meals are prepared and served promptly. His focus on efficiency and reliability helps the team stay fueled and focused. Ricardo believes that a well-fed team is a winning team, and he takes pride in contributing to their success behind the scenes. His dedication and attention to detail make him an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.description: A stocky man with a warm smile and hands that look like they've seen a lot of work.

quirks: Insists on using only olive oil from his family's village.
Always has a stash of Spanish almonds for a quick energy boost.
Refers to the drivers by affectionate nicknames based on their eating habits.
